extraction.description: The screenshot shows UiPath Studio Web in the Debug configuration view for the Benefit Claims Processing Template, specifically the Process Benefits Application project. The Project arguments tab is selected, and the input argument In_Application is populated with the file name "Sample application.pdf". The left Explorer panel shows the project structure with Process Benefits Application expanded and Main.xaml visible.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on Process Benefits Application in the Explorer if it is not already selected. In the In_Application field under Project arguments, enter Sample application.pdf. Click on Save & Debug to start debugging with the configured argument.
